QUOTE: Suites annotated with `TEST_CF_SECRET` and `TEST_CF_PUBLIC` are run under Valgrind (`MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND`) or MSan. Any branch or address that depends on a marked secret shows up as an uninitialized-value error (`tests/scripts/components-sanitizers.sh:12-21,115-135`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the Valgrind/MSan constant-flow testing, but it never says the facility is off-by-default or that it is explicitly not part of the library API.
